verdict: Good app, but not top-tier yet
verdict_explanation: Build is globally green for the first time (17 suites, 84 tests, all passing). Package DAG and RTK slice ownership are architecturally honest. Main gaps: `persistenceMiddleware` writes ambient `localStorage` without injection (test-environment leaks on every run); `undoRedoThunks` cross-slice behavior has zero unit tests; `TierBoardPage.tsx` at 757 LOC is a god-component.

architecture_quality.proof: packages/core/src/index.ts (no React imports); packages/state/src/store.ts only imports from @tiercade/core; TierBoardPage.tsx:757 LOC conflates multiple concerns

state_management.proof: packages/state/src/selectors.ts — memoized selectors for all 6 slices; persistenceMiddleware.ts:9 module-level saveTimeout singleton outside Redux

domain_modeling.proof: packages/core/src/models.ts:6 Item interface; packages/core/src/project.ts:108 Project schema; Item.name?: string vs ProjectItem.title: string mapping gap

data_flow.proof: workspace package.json enforces DAG: core←state←apps; persistenceMiddleware.ts:63 ambient localStorage.getItem without injection

framework_idioms.proof: AppShell.tsx:8-12 React lazy; selectors.ts createSelector throughout; persistenceMiddleware.ts:40 localStorage.setItem no typeof window guard

concurrency.proof: No floating Promises in thunks; persistenceMiddleware.ts:22-44 clearTimeout/setTimeout debounce pattern correct; module-level saveTimeout singleton is SPA-acceptable

simplicity.proof: TierBoardPage.tsx:757 LOC (7 useState, 3 useEffect, drag-drop, modals, URL sharing, export, keyboard shortcuts in one component); ImportExportPage.tsx:438 LOC

test_strategy.proof: packages/core 11 suites 69 tests (all pure functions covered); packages/state 4 suites 10 tests; undoRedoThunks.ts zero tests; persistenceMiddleware.ts zero tests

credibility.proof: packages/core domain solid; RTK slice ownership honest; test-environment localStorage leaks visible on every test run; 3:1 test-depth imbalance core vs state

authority_map.concern: Tier state (tiers, tierOrder, tierLabels, tierColors, selection, projectName)
authority_map.persistence_seam: persistenceMiddleware writes state.tier to localStorage after every action (debounced 500ms)

authority_map.concern: Head-to-head session (isActive, pool, pairsQueue, currentPair, phase, artifacts)

strengths: packages/core domain layer is framework-free (no React imports); 11 suites 69 tests; pure domain functions tested end-to-end.
RTK slice ownership: one clear owner per mutable concern across 6 slices; memoized selectors in selectors.ts cover all derived state.
Monorepo DAG enforced by workspace package.json: core←state←apps; no circular dependencies.
E2E suite (8 spec files in apps/web/e2e/) provides feature-level regression coverage for primary user flows.
HeadToHeadLogic (Wilson score, two-phase algorithm) is deeply implemented and tested in packages/core/test/.

findings.title: Build failure blocks structural review
findings.why_it_matters: Without a green baseline test suite, every architectural claim was unverifiable — F-001 is now resolved.
findings.what_is_wrong: The last remaining test failure was packages/state/test/importJSON.test.ts using a stale legacy {tiers/tierOrder} fixture that was never supported by ModelResolver.decodeProject. Fixed this loop.
findings.metric_signal: npm run test:core && test:state && test:ui: 17 suites, 84 tests, all PASS (loop 5 canonical run).
findings.minimal_correction_path: Resolved: updated test fixture to use valid Project schema.

findings.title: persistenceMiddleware writes ambient localStorage without injection — untestable seam
findings.why_it_matters: A middleware that writes durable user state cannot be unit-tested; any regression in save/load behavior is invisible to CI until a user loses data.
findings.what_is_wrong: persistenceMiddleware.ts:63 calls localStorage.getItem at store init (module load in tests); persistenceMiddleware.ts:40 calls localStorage.setItem in a debounce timer that fires after test teardown. Both are bare localStorage references with no typeof window guard and no injected dependency.
findings.leverage_impact: Callers must know that persistenceMiddleware depends on a global browser API — leaked into test environment.
findings.locality_impact: Persistence failure behavior (corrupted JSON, quota exceeded) is untestable; bugs there cannot be caught by unit tests.
findings.metric_signal: ExperimentalWarning: localStorage is not available + Cannot log after tests are done — printed on every npm run test:state run.
findings.why_weakens_submission: Un-seamed ambient dependency causes visible test warnings and zero persistence unit test coverage.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Add typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' guard in loadPersistedState and in the debounce callback's setItem call. This clears test warnings without a full injection refactor.

findings.title: undoRedoThunks — multi-slice behavior with zero direct tests
findings.why_it_matters: Undo/redo is a primary user feature; the cross-slice thunk path has zero unit tests, making any regression invisible to CI.
findings.what_is_wrong: undoRedoThunks.ts:22-56 (performUndo/performRedo) dispatches into two slices (undoRedoSlice + tierSlice); the snapshot round-trip is not tested anywhere in packages/state/test/.
findings.leverage_impact: Without tests, every future change to undoRedoThunks carries blind regression risk.
findings.locality_impact: Bug surface for undo/redo spreads across two slice reducers and one thunk file with no test boundary.
findings.why_weakens_submission: Primary user feature (undo/redo) with zero unit test coverage at the thunk interface.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Add packages/state/test/undoRedoThunks.test.ts covering: captureSnapshot pushes snapshot, performUndo restores prior state, performRedo restores undone state, new action after undo clears future. Use real store instance (same pattern as importJSON.test.ts).

findings.title: TierBoardPage.tsx at 757 LOC — god-component fails shallow-module test
findings.why_it_matters: A 757-LOC component cannot be modified in one concern without risk to the others; tests at this surface are impractical.
findings.what_is_wrong: TierBoardPage.tsx concentrates: 7 useState (independent concerns), 3 useEffect, drag-drop handlers, URL sharing import, export, keyboard shortcuts, presentation mode activation, and item modals in one React component.
findings.leverage_impact: Every concern bundled into TierBoardPage must be understood to modify any one of them.
findings.locality_impact: Bug in URL sharing or export requires navigating 757 LOC of unrelated code.
findings.metric_signal: 757 LOC vs 95 LOC for ThemesPage.tsx — ratio 8:1.
findings.why_weakens_submission: God-component resists maintenance and unit testing at the individual behavior level.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Extract URL-sharing import useEffect (lines 139-154) into useShareImport hook — self-contained behavior, ~15 lines, zero blast radius to other page behavior.

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: localStorage guard in persistenceMiddleware — passes Deletion test: removing the ambient access removes the leak; the guard is the honest minimum.
simplification_check.helpful_simplification: undoRedoThunks tests add zero ceremony — pure behavioral assertion at the existing thunk interface.
simplification_check.should_not_be_done: Introduce a full Storage port with two adapters as Priority 1 — overshoots the guard-only fix needed this loop.
simplification_check.tests_after_fix: No test deletions; add undoRedoThunks.test.ts at the thunk interface; persistence guard fix requires no new tests.

deepening_candidates.source_friction_proven: F2 — ambient localStorage causes test-environment leaks
deepening_candidates.why_shallow_or_misplaced: Middleware calls localStorage directly without injection; no test seam exists for persistence behavior.
deepening_candidates.behavior_to_move_behind_interface: getItem, setItem, removeItem calls in persistenceMiddleware.ts
deepening_candidates.test_surface_after_change: persistenceMiddleware.test.ts asserts save/load/clear against in-memory Storage stub
deepening_candidates.smallest_first_step: Add typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' guard (Priority 1 fix); injection refactor is next-loop work if guard is insufficient.
deepening_candidates.what_not_to_do: Do not introduce a StoragePort protocol with one prod adapter before the guard fix lands.

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Test output shows ExperimentalWarning: localStorage is not available. The global is accessed at module evaluation time, before the test environment sets up globals.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Guard localStorage/sessionStorage access with typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' before use, or inject the Storage interface so tests can pass a stub.
builder_notes.stack_example: persistenceMiddleware.ts:63: const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) should be const saved = typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) : null

builder_notes.pattern: Cross-slice thunks with no integration test
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: A thunk file dispatches to two different slice reducers. The test suite has per-slice tests but no test exercising the combined round-trip.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: For every thunk that spans 2+ slices, add one integration test using a real store instance that asserts the final state across both slices after dispatch.
builder_notes.stack_example: undoRedoThunks.ts: captureSnapshot → performUndo → performRedo dispatch into different slices; a test should check state.undoRedo.past, state.undoRedo.future, AND state.tier.tiers after each call.

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: A React page component over ~300 LOC with 5+ useState calls for independent concerns and 3+ useEffect calls.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Each self-contained behavior (URL sharing on mount, keyboard shortcuts, export, presentation) becomes one custom hook named use<Behavior>. The page component becomes a coordinator of hooks and a single JSX tree.
builder_notes.stack_example: TierBoardPage.tsx:139-154 URL share import useEffect — no local state dependencies; extracting to useShareImport() costs ~15 lines and zero blast radius.

narrative: Good app, place but not win. Five loops to reach green baseline; the first structural review confirms monorepo package boundaries and RTK slice ownership are architecturally honest. packages/core is framework-free and deeply tested. The gaps are real but fixable: persistenceMiddleware writes ambient localStorage without isolation (test warnings fire on every run); undo/redo cross-slice thunks have zero unit tests; TierBoardPage.tsx at 757 LOC is a god-component. Runtime ownership is trustworthy within Redux state. Concurrency is not a concern. Future work should not over-engineer: the persistence guard is a 3-line fix; the undo/redo test is a ~40-line addition; TierBoardPage decomposition should be incremental.

loop_result.what_changed: Updated packages/state/test/importJSON.test.ts — replaced stale legacy {tiers/tierOrder} fixture with valid Project schema (schemaVersion:1, projectId, tiers:ProjectTier[], items:Record<string,ProjectItem>, audit); renamed test to 'loads a project JSON with items in the unranked tier'.
loop_result.evidence_change_is_honest: npm run test:core && test:state && test:ui (loop 5): 17 suites, 84 tests — all PASS. First globally green run across all three workspaces.
